law: Hegyi2004 Eq3.9: sum(outlet_density^2)/sum(outlet_density), using existing dynamic connector stock/physical lane-km.
changed: Aggregate anticipation virtual downstream density at existing off-ramp source cells only
limitation: The connector is one lumped outlet cell; its mean density may miss an internal queue-front position. Formula is not a new capacity benefit.
acceptance: Improve paired deltaTTT and cumulative departure errors while retaining meaningful benefit/harm signs and not worsening stock/flow RMSE by more than10%. No subsequent coefficient sweep.
scope: East31 plus8connector costs, not fullOmega; known states, not pristine holdouts
